qualification: Search compares 112 independently recovered private values and 681 raw/prefix/JSON encoded MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 identifiers, in hexadecimal and raw digest bytes. Gzip/tar are traversed recursively with stated bounds; raw tar, gzip, filenames and metadata are searched too. Unknown values, hashes, encodings and formats remain outside scope. No private values or individual digests are reported; no product code executed.
